summary: Validated public API and mobile web preview. Auth/RBAC, consumer search/detail/favorite/click, owner metrics/catalog navigation, and admin KPIs/search passed. Consumer review modal did not become visible after tapping Avaliar Loja.

integration_issues.flow: Consumer store detail -> Avaliações -> Avaliar Loja
integration_issues.issue: After tapping open-add-review-modal-btn in the consumer demo flow, add-review-modal was not visible within 3 seconds; likely demo auth state was unavailable or tap routed to login.

action_items: Reproduce consumer demo login followed by review submission; ensure switchDemoRole persists the user before store detail opens.
Align frontend environment naming with the required EXPO_BACKEND_URL contract, or explicitly document EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL as the supported key.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/.env does not define EXPO_BACKEND_URL; it defines EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, while the requested deployment contract specifies EXPO_BACKEND_URL.
Backend uses fallback defaults for MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, and JWT_SECRET despite the environment contract requiring missing configuration to fail fast.
Expo logs contained an initial react-native-svg resolution failure and a passlib/bcrypt version warning; current preview recovered and API tests passed, but dependency versions should be stabilized.
seed_data_creation: None; used existing seeded demo data. One TEST_ product was created, updated, and deleted during regression testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview: https://city-shop-hub-3.preview.emergentagent.com. Credentials are in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Backend regression tests require EXPO_BACKEND_URL set from the app's current EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL.
rca_of_issue: Review modal reproduction: enter consumer demo, open store_1, select store-tab-reviews, tap open-add-review-modal-btn; add-review-modal did not appear. The handler only opens the modal when useAuth().user exists and otherwise routes to /auth/login, so the likely root cause is missing/stale consumer user state after demo navigation; verify AuthContext switchDemoRole persistence and route timing.
